# Read-Correctness Checklist: Home roll-up

**Purpose**: Validate that the **requirements** governing Home's five reads — their scope, window, ordering, arithmetic, deduplication and read boundary — are complete, unambiguous and objectively verifiable before any query is written
**Created**: 2026-09-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/queries.md](../contracts/queries.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## The due-this-week window

- [ ] CHK001 Is "the server's own configured timezone" defined precisely — the database session's `TimeZone` or the Node process's — so two readers cannot resolve it differently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, quickstart Prerequisites]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the window's four boundary days enumerated as requirements (today, +6, +7, −1), so an off-by-one is detectable from the spec text alone? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, US1 s4, research.md F-2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are both exclusions — a null due date and an already-past due date — stated as separate requirements rather than folded into one range? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the window's behaviour across a DST transition or an operator changing the installation's timezone mid-day? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-008, SC-013]

## Scope, filters and the read boundary

- [ ] CHK005 Is the absence of a project-status filter on **Assigned to you**, **Mentions** and **Recent activity** stated as a positive requirement, or only inferable from FR-014's exclusivity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the row-level scope requirement stated for **both** notification surfaces — the unbounded unread count and the five-row list — not just the list? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §FR-027, `OT-AUTHZ-003`]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the distinction between the membership **list** and the `isMember` predicate stated as a requirement, so an admin never added to a project is defined as excluded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, research.md B-4]
- [ ] CHK008 Is FR-035's obligation — the route MUST declare no `params`, no `searchParams` and no body, and MUST therefore read no query, path or body value — stated as a criterion a reviewer can check on the route's signature, rather than as an intent? [Measurability, Spec §FR-035, plan.md Principle II, research.md D-4]
- [ ] CHK009 Is `limit` on the installation-wide activity read required to be a fixed value rather than a caller-supplied one, given the exported signature accepts it as an argument? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-028, contracts/queries.md §1 and §4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the shared public projection's field set stated where FR-037 relies on it, so "no `user` field outside" it is verifiable rather than assumed? [Traceability, Spec §FR-037, data-model.md §1]

## Ordering and determinism

- [ ] CHK011 Is the alphabetical ordering the contract gives **Your projects** stated as a requirement anywhere, given FR-036 exempts that section from the instant tiebreak and obliges it only to "order deterministically"? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-036, contracts/queries.md §5]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the tiebreak requirement stated for ties spanning the two source tables of **Recent activity**, not only for ties within one table? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-036, data-model.md §4]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "newest first" for **Assigned to you** bound to a named field — issue creation, assignment, or last update? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "the twenty most recent" defined as a property of the stored rows rather than of a reader's collapsing, in a way FR-031 makes testable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-028, §FR-031]

## Progress arithmetic

- [ ] CHK015 Are the `board_column.kind` values that form the numerator and the excluded set enumerated, rather than referenced only as "`done`-kind" and "`canceled`-kind"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the denominator's treatment specified for an issue that sits in no column, or in a column whose kind is neither `done` nor `canceled`? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK017 Are all five rounding cases specified with an expected value (3/8, 0/0, 199/200, 200/200, 0/5), so a clamp-everything implementation cannot satisfy the written rule? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019, data-model.md §3.2, research.md F-2]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the two endpoints stated as separate requirements — a complete project reads 100%, an incomplete one never does — rather than as one rounding sentence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the zero-denominator outcome specified against every alternative it forbids (blank, dash, "n/a", error), so partial compliance is detectable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, SC-004]

## Recent activity, mentions and derived rows

- [ ] CHK020 Is it specified **which** of the two rows a comment produces is the one that renders, and what that choice implies for the row's link target? [Gap, Spec §FR-029, research.md B-5]
- [ ] CHK021 Is it specified whether every activity type R7 writes is eligible for **Recent activity**, or whether any type beyond `comment` is excluded? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-028, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for an activity or comment row whose target issue or project has since been deleted, as they are for a deleted comment behind a mention? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a mention notification whose actor row is absent rather than merely deactivated? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the actor's rendered name form required to follow the same display-name rule as the greeting across mention and activity rows? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-024, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK025 Is FR-022's prohibition — mentions read from `notification`, never re-derived from comment bodies — expressed as a checkable criterion rather than an intent? [Measurability, Spec §FR-022, contracts/queries.md §3]

## Coupling, bounds and assumptions

- [ ] CHK026 Is the requirement that the assigned card and its section derive from **one** read stated in the spec, or only asserted as a design property of the plan? [Traceability, Spec §FR-007, SC-002, research.md B-2]
- [ ] CHK027 Is SC-003's "the same number" between the unread card and the sidebar expressed as the same count, or only as two values that must agree? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK028 Is any bound, response-size or latency expectation stated for the unbounded **Assigned to you** section and the two knowingly unindexed read patterns? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, plan.md Complexity Tracking]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK011 is the item most likely to fail review: FR-036 now exempts **Your projects** from the instant tiebreak and requires only deterministic ordering, so the alphabetical key itself lives in the contract alone. CHK008 no longer records a conflict — FR-035 now obliges the route to declare no `params`, no `searchParams` and no body, which is what the design does — and asks only that the obligation be checkable on the route's signature
